result.reason: The six-month transition assistance at then-current rates meets the preferred position, and the addition is otherwise targeted. However, data return is required within 30 days of Customer's request, not within 30 days after expiry or termination, so Vendor has no export or subsequent deletion obligation absent a request. In addition, the margin comment incorrectly states that the Section 16.5 cross-reference was fixed; it still refers only to Sections 11 and 15 and omits new Section 10.3.
